This stuns towers for 1 second and deals 100 damage to units in its explosion range of 6. }} ==Description== '''Performer''' was a [[Flying]] enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had a quite low amount of health and slightly fast speed. As it was a [[Flying]] enemy, only towers with flying detection can target it. Upon death, it will launch itself at a tower in its range of 40 but not in its minimal range of 5, causing an explosion with a range of 6 that can stun towers for 1 second and deals 100 damage to units. ==Logbook Description== "''The Performer leaps into the air to perform acrobatics. Their bodies are made of paper, making them light enough to stay airborne for extended periods of time. For entertainment, the Narrator will sometimes swat one out of the sky and watch the confetti fall to the floor. This always seems to give him a laugh.''" ==Appearance== The '''Performer''' is a floating, green, blue, yellow and pink piñata with an animal head. It floats in the air and holds onto a hoop. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *Early-game towers with flying detection are best options against the '''Performer'''. Such towers include the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Soldier]] and [[Golden Crook Boss]]. **The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used to kill multiple at once. *Later on, high DPS towers with flying detection can be used to easily kill this. Such towers include the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Engineer]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} PerformerFly.gif|Flying animation (20 December 2025 – Present) PerformerStun.gif|Stun animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpsePerformer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} PerformerIconIG.png|'''Performer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Performer''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. == Update History == *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Performer''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Performer''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Extra B]]|Wave 7|Performer|Wave 8|[[Exo Follower]] & [[Exo Guard]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
